terms.seniorPremium: Bank states the senior-citizen premium on resident term deposits (see the page's notes list, not a table) — check the current figure on the page as it has changed before (0.15% -> 0.25% p.a. in one revision seen this session); this adapter reads the printed senior table rather than adding a premium itself.
terms.prematurePenalty: 1% below the card rate for the period held, or the contracted rate, whichever is lower (bank's own wording); non-callable rows cannot be withdrawn before maturity at all.
